word: Title: Morning At The Science Fair
answer: Mañana En La Feria De Ciencias

word: I result in the first group for the presentation.
answer: Resulto en el primer grupo para la presentación.

word: You withdraw the extra materials from the table. [sing, inf]
answer: Retiras los materiales extra de la mesa.

word: We are going to gather the students soon.
answer: Vamos a reunir a los estudiantes pronto.

word: They reveal their project with excitement.
answer: Revelan su proyecto con emoción.

word: I go around the room to check each stand.
answer: Rodeo el salón para revisar cada puesto.

word: You are going to break the model if you push it. [pl]
answer: Van a romper el modelo si lo empujan.

word: We take out the posters for our display.
answer: Sacamos los carteles para nuestra exhibición.

word: They separate the samples by color.
answer: Separan las muestras por color.

word: You point out the main idea clearly. [sing, formal]
answer: Señala la idea principal claramente.

word: I am going to mean something different in my explanation.
answer: Voy a significar algo diferente en mi explicación.

word: We locate our project near the entrance.
answer: Situamos nuestro proyecto cerca de la entrada.

word: They request more time to finish.
answer: Solicitan más tiempo para terminar.

word: You submit your results to the judges. [sing, inf]
answer: Sometes tus resultados a los jueces.

word: We are going to sound the alarm for the demo.
answer: Vamos a sonar la alarma para la demostración.

word: They surprise everyone with a cool experiment.
answer: Sorprenden a todos con un experimento padre.

word: You go up the small stage to speak. [pl]
answer: Suben al pequeño escenario para hablar.

word: I suffer a bit of nervousness.
answer: Sufro un poco de nervios.

word: We add one more detail to the poster.
answer: Sumamos un detalle más al cartel.

word: They are going to go beyond expectations today.
answer: Van a superar las expectativas hoy.

word: You throw away the scraps from the table. [sing, formal]
answer: Tira los recortes de la mesa.

word: I touch the model carefully.
answer: Toco el modelo con cuidado.

word: We transform the idea into something bigger.
answer: Transformamos la idea en algo más grande.

word: They try a new way to explain it.
answer: Tratan una forma nueva de explicarlo.

word: You are going to locate the judges soon. [sing, inf]
answer: Vas a ubicar a los jueces pronto.

word: We join the final group for photos.
answer: Unimos al grupo final para las fotos.
